mapper.sql: id, dept_name, dept_code, description, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT id, dept_name, dept_code, description, create_time, update_time, deleted, dept_name as name, dept_code as code FROM department WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (dept_name, dept_code, description) VALUES (#{deptName}, #{deptCode}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name as name, COUNT(er.id) as count FROM department d LEFT JOIN class_info c ON d.id = c.department_id LEFT JOIN student s ON c.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN exam_record er ON s.id = er.student_id AND er.status >= 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name ORDER BY count DESC
